Message.MsgText: Unable to open 'file name' for modification. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: The file indicated in the error message that must be altered by the Update Installer cannot be opened.

Message.MsgText: Error closing 'file name'. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: An error occurred while closing a file. If the file was being read, this error may be ignored. If the file was being written, all of the data may not have been written correctly.

OperatorResponse.p: Inspect the file mentioned in the error message for correctness.

Message.MsgText: Usage: ACSIIFileUpdate file search replacement [LINE|TEXT]

Explanation.p: An incorrect call was made to ASCIIFileUpdate.

OperatorResponse.p: If this message is seen while running the Update Installer,

Message.MsgText: Unable to find 'file name'.

Explanation.p: The file indicated in the error message that must be altered by the Update Installer cannot be found.

Message.MsgText: Error reading 'file name'. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: The file indicated in the error message is not altered.

OperatorResponse.p: Run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: Error reading from input stream. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: An error occurred while reading the input stream from an opened file. The operation being performed did not complete.

OperatorResponse.p: Run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: Error processing file 'file name'. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: The file indicated in the error message could not be read. The operation being performed did not complete.

OperatorResponse.p: Run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: Unable to create script file 'file name'. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: An error occurred while trying to create a temporary script for execution.

OperatorResponse.p: Inspect the accompanying exception information to fix the error and run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: Error while executing an operating system command. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: An error occurred while executing a shell script.

OperatorResponse.p: Inspect the accompanying exception information to fix the error and run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: While executing an operating system command, a non-zero return code was returned. Return code=return code; Message: message

Explanation.p: A non-zero return code was found while executing a shell script.

OperatorResponse.p: Inspect the additional information in the message. If this information indicates a fatal error, run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: component already has this fix applied and will not be updated.
Unable to process fix file 'file name'.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the file specified is correct and exists. If so,

Explanation.p: The Update Installer was unable to find the specified install directory.

Message.MsgText: No .registry file was found in the install directory, the file was empty, or it could not be read.

Explanation.p: The Update Installer was unable to find the .registry file in the install directory.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the directory specified is correct and contains the .registry file. If it does,

Message.MsgText: Unable to open the .registry file for writing.

Explanation.p: The fix has been applied, but the .registry file could not be updated.

OperatorResponse.p: Reapply the fix, or update the .registry file manually.

Message.MsgText: Unable to create file or directory 'file or directory name' when extracting from 'file name'.

Explanation.p: A file or directory could not be created.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that permissions are correct and there is enough space on the system and run the Update Installer again.

Message.MsgText: Unable to extract 'file name' from 'zip file'. An exception occurred: exception info

Explanation.p: An error occurred while attempting to extract a file from an archive.

OperatorResponse.p: Inspect the exception information to fix the problem. If the problem persists,

Message.MsgText: File 'file name' does not exist in archive 'zip file'.

Explanation.p: A file that should be present in the indicated archive cannot be found.

Message.MsgText: Unable to process .registry file in install directory 'directory'.

Explanation.p: The .registry file in the indicated install directory could not be processed.

OperatorResponse.p: See other messages issued for futher information.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that permissions are correct and there is enough space on the sytstem. Create the directory manually or run the Update Installer again.
